baselineRegression.method: Eight selected final tests against isolated turn-start Settings and AppContext copies. All eight parameterized cases fail; forty-nine other cases excluded from this baseline-only run. Failures can stop at their first assertion, and do not represent eight independent defects.

changes: Removed browser model configuration/map reads and writes. Reasoning and vision configs now carry their confirmed provider-model maps in AppContext; server preferences remain the persistence source. Four legacy browser keys are removed on module startup, without migrating unowned values into a logged-in account.

Account identity transitions and logout clear both role states and invalidate old reads/writes. New-account queues are independent of pending old-account operations; failed old-account saves cannot revert new-account input. Preferences are loaded after authentication and again when the uid changes.

Removed duplicate reasoning/vision preference fetch/parsing branches and the frontend provider-default tables. An unknown model for a newly selected provider is resolved by existing backend persistence logic; explicit selections and confirmed inactive-provider choices remain preserved.

Generation, world and retrieval settings block their form after failed or malformed reads and offer retry. Required nested primitive fields and model-map value types are checked before applying confirmations. A rejected save leaves the current draft intact.

Provider rows and the reasoning role use confirmed context maps instead of browser caches. Removed the two duplicated embedding/rerank patch setters; retained role-specific provider selection and UI controls.

Removed obsolete cache-failure injection from writer tests; added real AppProvider account/cache scenarios, provider-row account transition checks, settings read/retry/schema cases and backend default delegation checks. Updated the authentication recovery fixture dependency for the session setter.
preserved: Server-side per-user preferences and saved model maps, selected model IDs, fallback policy, and credential save/verification behavior.
Independent reasoning and vision write queues, update confirmation requirements, request ownership, and explicit model routing.
All previous prune40?52 changes as verified against their latest recorded fingerprints.
limitations: Tests include six mounted real AppProvider cases, component/function extraction with mocked transports, and isolated backend fixtures. This is not a live server/model or native-client end-to-end acceptance.

No full-suite rerun, live model calls, visual acceptance, latency benchmark, backend rebuild, commit, push or client restart. Legacy browser-key removal will run on the next frontend module load; real user preferences were not changed during this work.
Canceling or changing accounts cannot undo server writes already accepted under the previous identity. Multiple windows/clients remain outside the local queue transaction boundary.

Specialized settings validation checks nested shape and finite numeric values; provider/model authorization and semantic validation remain backend responsibilities. AppContext reasoning/vision reads still have no dedicated user-facing load-error/retry state; their last/default state can remain visible on a read error.

Removing unowned caches intentionally drops browser-only choices never confirmed by the backend; saved backend preferences remain intact. It does not migrate or scope unrelated voice, tool, organization or personal-case browser caches.
Case-write coalescing, personal-case cache isolation and other application partitions remain open.
